profile.headline: Roboticist | STEAM Educator | Consultant | Forbes 30 Under 30
profile.summary:
Please visit my website for information on current research and projects: www.nialahwilsonsmall.com

I have developed coordination algorithms for large collectives of flexible modular robots. My current research focus is human-drone interactions. Specifically, I study how drones can use tactile feedback to influence human motion.

company.name: The Robotics, Automation, and Dance (RAD) Lab

positions.title: Industry Assistant Professor
positions.description: Skills: Multi-robot systems · Human-robot Interaction · Teaching

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Designed motion primitives and scalable coordination algorithms for a novel flexible modular robot. Developed an open-source simulation in MATLAB to model the robot’s behavior in complex environments. Designed systems for tactile human-drone interaction.

TA for Mixed Reality, CS 5678
TA for Mechatronics, MAE 3780

positions.title: Weight Engineer Intern (BCA)
positions.description: Performed stress analysis using Altair HyperWorks software to reduce the weight of various components on the 777 and optimize performance. Collaborated across Product Development departments to provide accurate weight estimates to inform trade studies for a freighter configuration.

positions.title: Metrology and Test Equipment Services, Boeing Test and Evaluation (BT&E)-EAHI Hire
positions.description:
Developed and implemented a system including the programming, bracket design, and hardware electronics to replace the current laser interferometer with a linear optical encoder to be utilize in the Photometry Lab. I performed tests on the system to ensure accuracy and repeatability.

The Boeing Engineering Accelerated Hiring Initiative (EAHI) is a competitive, unique opportunity for students to gain an in depth look at the company through targeted internships. There are 20 participating colleges and universities.

positions.title: Year-Round (Telecommuter) Research & Development Intern
positions.description: Conducted research in the Thermal/Fluids Experimentation Sciences department. I used various laboratory equipment to characterize bellows (springs) and test their effect on dynamic systems with damping and multiphase flow under high vibration conditions. I utilized MATLAB to write multiple scripts to analyze the data sets and created documentation for the various processes I used during the experiments. I had the opportunity to present my work at a poster session for interns at the end of the summer.

positions.title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
positions.description: Gantry Project: I was in charge of designing configurations for multi-axis linear electromechanical actuator systems. I used SolidWorks 2012 to design the brackets, support trays, and cable carrying systems necessary.
